requirements.statement: Every command that produces a document records it in .trd-state/<feature>/artifacts.json under its kind as {path, url, updated_at, command}, beside a top-level "version": 2, through one lib helper. No command writes the JSON itself.
The recorded path names a file that exists on disk, for each kind: prd, trd, audit-prd, audit-trd, success-definition, verification-plan, verification-report, audit-build.
An old manifest (one claude.ai URL string per kind) is read as {url} and upgraded to the version-2 shape in place on the next write, keeping every URL it held.
With ensemble.publishArtifacts: false the path is still recorded and url is left empty.

/audit-prd and /audit-trd write .trd-state/<feature>/audit-prd-report.md / audit-trd-report.md the way /audit-build writes its report: VERDICT line first, then a header (date, audited commit, document path), then the readout word for word.
After /init-project and after /rebase-project (every mode, --preserve-all included), .claude/settings.json has ensemble.version set to the plugin version.
packages/core and the vendored .claude copy stay byte-identical for every file this change touches.

Jest on artifacts.js: each of the eight document kinds records a path that exists with version 2; URL-only file reads as {url} (audit-build-report read as audit-build) and is rewritten as version 2 on record keeping other URLs; record without URL stores url "" for new kind and keeps existing URL; repeated identical record leaves bytes unchanged; record throws on missing file, absolute path, ../ escape and kind version, leaving manifest unchanged; CLI get prints only URL, or nothing when absent or "".
requirements.source: TRD Master Task List FIX-001 acceptance criteria

tasks.description: Add packages/core/lib/artifacts.js (read, get, record, CLI read/get/record), its Jest tests, the packages/full/lib/artifacts.js symlink and the vendored .claude/lib/artifacts.js copy.

Wire prd, trd and audit-build recording into create-prd, refine-prd, create-trd, refine-trd, plan and audit-build. Each reads its stored URL with artifacts.js get, publishes as before, then records with artifacts.js record, publishing on or off. audit-build uses kind audit-build and always commits artifacts.json on a close.
/audit-prd and /audit-trd write .trd-state/<feature>/audit-prd-report.md and audit-trd-report.md (VERDICT line, then header, then readout verbatim) and record kinds audit-prd and audit-trd.

Record success-definition (implement-trd 8.1, verify-build steps 3/3a), verification-plan (refine-verification Writes) and verification-report plus check pages (implement-trd 9.0a, verify-build Artifact link), publishing on or off. Switch the readers (implement-trd 8.1b step 5, check-page comments; verify-build fix-loop step 4) to artifacts.js get.
Update command-status.md Artifact links section (template and vendored .claude/rules copy) to describe the version-2 manifest and the helper.

Add scaffold-project.sh --stamp-version (strict mode, writes version, refreshed_at, and in this mode only rebased_at and previous_version on change). Add a final step to rebase-project Step 4 running it, with all three copies identical. Make init-project (all three copies) re-run it when ensemble.version is missing and go STUCK if still missing.
